_doc: One case per chat.* command (internal/chatstore/commands.go), run by Go TestChatWritesCases and by the Swift ChatWritesFixtureTests against the Swift writer each case names in `swift`, until Task 18 deletes the Swift writers. Each side runs `seed` on a fresh database, calls its writer with `params` (Go adds request_id), and must leave exactly `check`'s rows. `refusal` and `result` are the Go command's answer (Swift writers throw or return false there). Time columns written from the clock are checked as `> 1000`.
